version.title: Open Shop Friday - Competency Development & Reassessment
learningTargets: I am learning to use feedback and my current competency ratings to identify a skill that needs improvement.
I am learning to safely and productively practice an appropriate welding or fabrication skill.
I am learning to demonstrate improvement through new evidence when I am ready for reassessment.
successCriteria: I can identify an appropriate competency or project goal.
I can use Open Shop time safely and productively.
I can apply instructor feedback while practicing.
I can demonstrate progress or provide new evidence toward competency proficiency.
engagementStrategies: Individualized skill practice, student choice within approved activities, targeted coaching, peer collaboration where appropriate, project completion, remediation, reassessment, and extension.
version.assessment: Observation, student work, weld/cut/project inspection, questioning, reassessment, and updated tracker evidence.

version.title: Advanced Welding Orientation & Safety Verification
learningTargets: I am learning to demonstrate advanced-shop safety practices.
I am learning to identify hazards in welding, cutting, fabrication, and material handling.
successCriteria: I can identify and correct hazards.
I can prepare work areas and equipment safely.
I can work safely with minimal prompting.
engagementStrategies: Brief orientation followed by hands-on PPE, equipment, work-area, and hazard verification. Use realistic shop scenarios; provide targeted support for new/transfer students.
version.assessment: Individual safety demonstration, observation, questioning, and competency evidence.
